user_story.user: BugNarrator macOS user selecting Local Parakeet
user_story.problem: Long local inference times out, retries duplicate work, a stale server API keyword fails large uploads, and release smoke tests do not exercise transcription.
user_story.desired_outcome: Reliable local transcription with reproducible, behavior-tested release artifacts.
non_goals: Changing OpenAI or compatible-provider semantics; broad UI redesign; deleting user recordings.

requirements: Preserve recordings and existing provider behavior
Do not use UI automation or take over the screen
acceptance_criteria: A loopback Parakeet request can run longer than 180 seconds without client timeout
A transient local timeout is not automatically duplicated
The standalone server transcribes a generated speech fixture before publication
Public app and server artifacts are signed/notarized and checksummed
contract.architecture_fit: Keep provider-specific policy in the transcription request/client boundary and server-specific behavior in local-transcription.
open_questions: coverage-probe (error-paths): What is the error / failure-path behavior?
coverage-probe (security): Any security / egress / secret-exposure impact?
coverage-probe (concurrency): Is the change concurrency-safe / idempotent / re-entrant?
coverage-probe (backward-compat): What is the backward-compat / consumer impact?
coverage-probe (rollback): Is there a rollback / undo path?
